# Has your GST turnover reached AUD 75,000, and when must you register?

> Free Australia GST registration checker: enter your last 12 months of sales to see whether GST turnover has reached AUD 75,000, test your projected turnover, and get your 21-day registration deadline. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
